# Fix ledger

> **Status of this ledger — close-out wave complete, 2026-08-21. `PENDING` is now zero.**
>
> Every row that read `PENDING` at the close of the engagement was checked against the tree one row
> at a time and flipped **only with evidence**: a `file:line` that was read, the commit whose diff
> was read, or the test that pins the behaviour. That evidence is in each row's note. No row in this
> file has been flipped on inference or on a commit message alone — several remediation commits cite
> id _ranges_, and a range mention proved repeatedly not to mean every id in it.
>
> The reconciliation pass at `345a0a8` left **13 rows genuinely `PENDING`** because the defect was
> still in the tree. **All 13 are now closed** — F-224, F-083, F-090, F-094, F-173, F-261, F-262,
> F-447, F-660, F-780, F-785, F-786, F-573 — by six parallel fix agents plus a seventh that finished
> the two residuals the others deferred rather than dropped. Each row's note names the mechanism, the
> `file:line`, and the failing-then-passing test. Every one of the 13 was independently spot-checked
> at its cited `file:line` before the row was flipped; none of the reports disagreed with the tree.
>
> **`PENDING` means _not done_, not _not recorded_.** That distinction is what this file previously
> could not make, and it is why three `HIGH` findings (F-102, F-206, F-207) hid in the pile until
> they were checked individually. It is now discharged: no row is `PENDING`.
>

> ### F-785 is the one split disposition, deliberately not flattened
>
> Its two halves got different answers and recording it as a plain `FIXED` would have buried one of
> them. **Secret scan: `FIXED`** — a fatal `secret-scan` step now sits at position 3 of `VERIFY_STEPS`
> (14 steps, up from 13), running `scripts/secret-scan.ts --tracked`. **`prettier --check`:
> `WONTFIX`, with the reason written down** — `prettier . --check` reports **809 differing files**, so
> the step cannot be added without a 809-file reformat in the same change; the decision and the
> figure are recorded in `docs/release.md:72`, not left silent. Tracked as N-035.
>

> this header's whole purpose:

> ### Gate, re-run for this header rather than quoted
>
> On the working tree as committed here: `tsc --noEmit` **0 errors**; `eslint . --max-warnings 0`
> **clean** (exit 0); `vitest run` **414 files / 4037 tests, 0 failures**. The 4033-test figure an
> agent reported mid-wave was stale — three agents landed work after it, and a 3-failure snapshot
> seen during the run was a fix agent's deliberate failing-first demonstration window, since
> restored and re-verified. `next build` was **not** run: it writes `.next/`, which the two live dev
> servers on `:3000` and `:3001` own, and restarting them was not permitted this round. It was green
> at the merge, and the only build-config change since (`next.config.ts` losing a
> `serverExternalPackages` entry for a package absent from both `package.json` and `node_modules`)
> cannot affect bundling — but it is unverified, and whoever owns the gate build should run it.
>
> **This commit contains `audit/**` only.** The source changes the 13 rows describe were uncommitted
> in the working tree when the ledger was written; staging them is the merge owner's step. One
> caveat worth passing on: several new test files are still untracked, which a `git commit -a` would
> miss.
>
> **Why this diff touches all 508 rows.** The notes added this wave are much longer than the ones
> they replaced, so `prettier` — which `lint-staged` runs on every staged `*.md` from
> `.husky/pre-commit` — re-pads the whole table to the new column width. That reformat was applied
> deliberately _before_ committing rather than left to mutate the file during the commit, and the
> invariants were then re-verified on the formatted output: 508 rows, 508 distinct ids, every row
> exactly 8 columns, no `PENDING`, tally still summing to 508. **Only the 13 rows named above changed
> meaning; the other 495 changed whitespace only.** This is the contained version of the reformat
> N-035 declines to do repo-wide.

One row per finding. The rule was that no row may end the engagement as `PENDING`, and as of this
wave that rule is met: the disposition column has no `PENDING` value left in it.
Generated in Wave 0 from the finding headings in every phase file; maintained by hand after that.

**508 findings** - the mechanical count from the phase files. `REPORT.md` §2 used to say 495, which
was the sum of the phase agents' self-reported totals; Phase 5b under-counted itself by 13. 508 is
correct, there are no duplicate ids, and every heading parsed cleanly. That table has since been
corrected to 508, and the correction is filed as N-001.

| F-785 | GAP         | P    | G16-test-gate                   | FIXED/WONTFIX | 6    |         | SPLIT, deliberately not flattened. **Secret scan: FIXED** (2026-08-21 close-out wave, TestGateHoles). A blocking defect was found first: wiring the existing tree mode into VERIFY_STEPS gives a gate that can NEVER be green, because tree mode walks gitignored files and reports the developer's own .env.local (exit 1) - recorded as N-033. So the input set changed instead: new `--tracked` mode in scripts/secret-scan.ts reading `git ls-files -z --cached` (:121-122,:174-184), which is exactly what a `--no-verify` commit deposited and from which ignored paths are absent by construction; a tracked path missing from the worktree is read from the index rather than failing the gate closed. The gitleaks second pass is now restricted to the default mode (:227-233) because `detect --no-git --source <cwd>` reads ignored files and would have reintroduced the same permanent red on any machine with gitleaks installed - N-034. New fatal `secret-scan` step at position 3, right after eslint (lib/verify/orchestrator.ts:132-136), so a leaked credential surfaces in the first seconds of a push; new `requireSecretsScanned()` (:95) demands `Secret scan passed (N file(s)` with N > 0, closing the exit-0 'nothing to scan' gap that exit codes alone do not cover. VERIFY_STEPS is now **14** steps; AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md corrected from 'thirteen'. Spot-checked by me: 14 ids in the VERIFY_STEPS array, `--tracked` present in orchestrator and script, gitleaks scoped to default mode. Evidence: tracked mode 'Secret scan passed (1923 file(s) scanned, 172 ignored)' exit 0 in 0.67s; docs-accuracy 22/22; verify-orchestrator 20/20; secret-scan 11/11. **`prettier --check`: WONTFIX with a documented reason.** `prettier . --check` reports **809 differing files** at 345a0a8. Adding the step means reformatting 809 files in one commit - conflicts with every branch in flight, buries real changes in whitespace for a year of git blame, and leaves the gate red for the whole window between adding the step and landing the reformat. Honest sequence: reformat first on a quiet tree, add the step second; neither half belongs in a finding whose subject is the missing secret scan. Declined in writing at docs/release.md:72 with the figure and the commit it was measured at, verified there by me. Tracked as N-035 |
